sitename.description: The name of your wiki site, displayed in browser title and page headers.

meta_namespace.description: The namespace used for project-related pages (e.g., Project:About).

logo_url.description: Relative or absolute URL to the site logo image.

script_path.description: Base path where MediaWiki is installed (e.g., '/w' for /w/index.php).

article_path.description: URL pattern for article pages; $1 is replaced with the page title.

use_path_info.description: Whether to use PATH_INFO in URLs (requires URL rewriting support).

db_server.description: Database server hostname or IP address.

db_name.description: Name of the database to use.

db_password.description: Password for database access (leave blank for no password).

db_options.description: Additional database options as a list of strings (e.g., ['mysql_charset' => 'utf8mb4']).

cache_directory.description: Directory for file-based caching (must be writable by web server).

memcached_servers.description: List of Memcached server addresses in 'host:port' format.

enable_markdown.description: Enable Markdown syntax in wiki pages (requires Extension:MarkdownExtra).

public_read.description: Allow anonymous users to read pages.

public_edit.description: Allow anonymous users to edit pages.

public_createaccount.description: Allow anonymous users to create accounts.

user_groups.description: Custom user groups and their permissions.

name.description: Extension name (e.g., 'VisualEditor', 'Math'). Required if 'path' is missing.

path.description: Full path to extension setup file (e.g., '/var/www/extensions/VisualEditor/VisualEditor.php'). Overrides 'name'.

debug_log_groups.description: Per-group debug logging configuration: map of group name → log file path.

debug_log_level.description: Minimum log level for debugging: 'debug', 'info', 'warning', 'error', or 'fatal'.
